items.title: Upland Iced Coffee
items.description: Our signature cold brew — steeped for 18 hours, smooth, bold, and naturally sweet. Served over ice.

items.title: Strawberry Frappe
items.description: Fresh strawberry blend with creamy milk and a swirl of house-made syrup. Refreshingly sweet.

items.title: Spanish Latte
items.description: Sweetened condensed milk meets double espresso over ice. Creamy, rich, and perfectly balanced.

items.title: Creamy Carbonara
items.description: Al dente pasta tossed in rich, creamy sauce with crispy bacon bits and parmesan. Served with garlic bread.

items.title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
items.description: Golden, buttery sourdough stuffed with melted mozzarella and cheddar. Served with chips on the side.

items.title: Loaded Fries
items.description: Crispy golden fries topped with cheese sauce, bacon bits, and a drizzle of ranch. Perfect for sharing.
